Name: Entomologist Spider Mount
Author: PumpedFail
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Replaces in-game horse with a spider mount, complete with animations and the ability to wear hats! Choose between a tarantula, a black widow, or a blue mine spider! Can also choose between saddled or bareback, and can add a spiderweb effect to the stables.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Unzip "Entomologist Spider Mount.zip" into the Stardew Valley/Mods directory.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Configure options using the mod config menu on the main menu or in the config menu in-game.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Enjoy![/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Replaces horse sprite with one of three spider options (tarantula, black widow, or blue mine spider)[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Choose between saddled or bareback for each spider.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- Add optional webbing overlay to stables, compatible with recolor.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url][/color][/size]

[b][size=4]A note on donations[/size][/b]
[size=3]- If you like the mod, I would love to accept your donations. All donations (along with any revenue generated through the Donation Points program) will be donated to St. Jude Children's Hospital.[/size]
